about.body: Flutter developer with 3+ years shipping production iOS and Android applications, with eight apps live on the App Store and Google Play across five markets. Sole author of six codebases totaling roughly 250,000 lines of Dart. I work with feature-first Clean Architecture, BLoC/Cubit and Riverpod, offline-first data layers, and payment integrations across RevenueCat, Telr, and wallet gateways. I build real-time features including WebRTC voice, SSE streaming, and Firebase Cloud Functions — and deliver Arabic-first RTL products for Saudi, Iraqi, Egyptian, Palestinian, and Qatari markets.
